issue_gist: The adaptive-step ODE integrator (e.g., DormandPrince853) treats the end of the integration range as an event, but numerical inaccuracy in event detection can cause the end event to be missed. The integrator then runs well past the requested end time, e.g. covering 160s instead of 60s.
